# Harvest Barn Inn (concept by Kerblabs)

> Guesthouse in a converted 19th century farmhouse in Bellows Falls, Vermont. Facts from harvestbarninn.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Location: 16 Webb Terrace, Bellows Falls, VT 05101
- Phone: (916) 276-9421
- Email: harvestbarninn@gmail.com
- Views of the Connecticut River (per their site)
- TripAdvisor: 5/5 average, as displayed on their site

## Offer
- Modern, comfortable rooms
- Kitchen and community space
- Breakfast (shown on their site)
